answer.rationale: With expiry in 14 days and the line at 94% of committed volume, changing primary supply or adding a source now creates unacceptable delivery and qualification risk. Negotiate an incumbent renewal immediately, using market benchmarking and a multi-year/volume structure to pursue the mandated cost reduction while preserving the proven integration and delivery continuity. The 18% target may not be fully achievable through terms alone, so that outcome remains uncertain pending verification and incumbent response.
